cover.headline: South Florida is in drama mode

slides.headline: Brightline hits bankruptcy court
slides.body: Brightline is reworking more than $5B in debt, but the Miami-to-Orlando trains will keep running. Cafecito panic postponed.

slides.headline: Billionaire helipad hits turbulence
slides.body: Ken Griffin is running into Miami resistance over a personal helipad. Even the sky has zoning drama now.

slides.headline: Police detail wild Hialeah chase
slides.body: Police reports detail an “erratic and reckless” chase of a Hialeah carjacking suspect, according to NBC 6.

slides.headline: Fake pay stubs, real consequences
slides.body: Florida’s new law targets rental fraud involving fake pay stubs, with changes for tenants and landlords.

slides.headline: New details in MIA gun arrest
slides.body: Authorities identified the MIA shooting suspect as a 31-year-old homeless man with a prior airport arrest in Los Angeles, Local 10 reports.

slides.headline: ‘Bloodline’ house is about to sell
slides.body: A Netflix “Bloodline” house in the Keys is about to sell. Cue every local suddenly becoming a real estate expert.
